title: Create Work Order from Template
description: Verify that a user can create a new work order by selecting and applying a template, filling in required details, and successfully saving it.

steps.description: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the Work Order creation page.
Select a predefined work order template from the template list.
Fill in the necessary details such as task description, department, assigned personnel, and site.
Submit the form to create the work order.
Confirm the work order is created with all selected template details and appears in the work order list.

title: Create Work Order from Scratch
description: Verify that a user can create a new work order without using a template and fill all required fields manually.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the new work order page.
Choose the option to create work order without template.
Manually enter task details, select department, assign user, and select site.
Submit the work order creation form.
Verify the new work order is created and correctly listed with all entered details.

title: Edit Existing Work Order
description: Verify that a user can update fields of an existing work order and save the changes.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the work order list.
Select an existing work order to view its details.
Modify fields such as status, assigned user, or task description.
Save the changes.
Confirm the work order details reflect the updated information.

title: Delete Work Order
description: Verify that a user with appropriate permissions can delete an existing work order and it no longer appears in the list.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the work order list.
Select a work order and initiate the delete operation.
Confirm the deletion when prompted.
Verify that the deleted work order is removed from the list and cannot be accessed.

title: Filter Work Orders by Department
description: Verify that filtering the work order list by a specific department shows only work orders associated with that department.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the work order dashboard.
Select a department filter from the department list or dropdown.
Check that all displayed work orders belong to the selected department.

title: Add a New Department
description: Verify that administrators can add a new department and it becomes available immediately for organizing work orders.

steps.description: Log in as an administrator and navigate to the department management page.
Enter the new department’s name and relevant details.
Save the new department.
Confirm that the new department appears in the department list and can be selected when managing work orders.

title: Edit Existing Department
description: Verify that an administrator can modify details of an existing department and the changes are reflected throughout the module.

steps.description: Log in as administrator and open the department management.
Select a department and edit its name or other attributes.
Save the changes.
Ensure the updated department information is visible in all relevant work order views and filters.

title: Remove Department with Assigned Work Orders
description: Verify behavior when deleting a department that has existing work orders; check for warnings, errors, or reassignment flows.

steps.description: Log in as administrator and navigate to the department management.
Attempt to delete a department currently assigned to active work orders.
Verify that a warning or error is shown preventing deletion or that the system prompts for reassignment of work orders.

title: Add a New Site with Geolocation Data
description: Verify that new physical sites can be added with required details including geolocation data, and that they appear correctly in site listings.

steps.description: Log in and navigate to the site management page.
Input new site information including name, address, and geolocation coordinates.
Save the new site.
Confirm the new site appears in the list and can be selected when creating or filtering work orders.

title: Edit Existing Site Details
description: Verify that users can update site details including address and geolocation and that updates are reflected system-wide immediately.

steps.description: Log in and open the site management interface.
Select an existing site and modify its details like address or geolocation.
Save the changes.
Validate the updated site info is displayed correctly throughout the application, including filters.

title: Delete Existing Site with Associated Work Orders
description: Verify that deletion of a site linked to existing work orders is handled properly, either by blocking deletion or requiring reassignment.

steps.description: Log in as administrator and access the site management page.
Attempt to delete a site linked to active work orders.
Check for appropriate warnings or error messages, and ensure no orphaned work orders result.

title: Apply Template During Work Order Creation
description: Verify that templates can be selected and applied during new work order creation and that all template data populates correctly.

steps.description: Start creation of a new work order.
Access the template selection and choose a valid template.
Ensure all fields populated by the template are correctly filled in the creation form.
Complete and save the work order.
Verify that the created work order contains the template’s default data.

title: Template Management Access and Visibility
description: Verify that templates are listed, and appropriately accessible only to authorized users.

steps.description: Log in as a user without template administration rights.
Confirm that template management features are not accessible or visible.
Log in as an administrator.
Verify template management features are accessible and templates are listed.

title: Unauthorized Access to Work Order Module
description: Verify that users without authentication cannot access any part of the Work Order Module, receiving appropriate access denied responses.

steps.description: Attempt to navigate directly to a Work Order Module URL without login.
Check that the user is redirected to the login page or shown an access denied message.

title: Session Expiration Handling
description: Verify the system behavior when an authenticated user's session expires during interaction with the Work Order Module.

steps.description: Log in and start interacting with work order pages.
Simulate session timeout or expiration.
Attempt to perform actions like creating or updating a work order.
Verify that the user is prompted to log in again, and actions are prevented until re-authentication.

title: UI Responsiveness on Various Devices
description: Verify that all core UI components of the Work Order Module render correctly and remain usable on different device screen sizes including desktop, tablet, and mobile.

steps.description: Access the Work Order Module using desktop, tablet, and mobile devices or emulators.
Confirm that menus, forms, lists, and buttons are properly laid out and work correctly without overflow or layout breakage.

title: Filter Work Orders by Site
description: Verify that filtering the work order list by physical site accurately shows only the work orders linked to that site.

steps.description: Navigate to the work order dashboard.
Apply a site filter by choosing a specific site.
Verify that only work orders associated with the selected site are displayed.

title: Work Order List Real-time Updates
description: Verify that updates to work orders (creation, edits, deletions) made by other users propagate in real-time and update the work order list view.

steps.description: Open the work order list view in two separate user sessions.
In one session, create or update a work order.
Confirm that the second session's work order list refreshes automatically to reflect the change without manual reload.
